questions.title: How many trillion dollar companies will there be on December 18, 2026?
questions.background:
As of October 2026, 5 companies are close to $1T: Berkshire Hathaway, Eli Lilly, Samsung, Micron Technology, and Walmart.

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "b229e182f0337b67", "sheet_id": "119"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve as the number of public companies with a market cap over USD $1 trillion on December 18, 2026.
The primary source for this question will be [CompaniesMarketCap](https://companiesmarketcap.com/).
questions.fine_print: This question will resolve based upon the number following US market closure at 4:00 PM ET.
